f.title: Include the minimum ESAVI information when notifying CECMED
f.statement: The minimum information for notifying an ESAVI to CECMED is: an identifiable patient (name and surnames or initials); a suspect vaccine (generic or trade name, batch number, expiry date, manufacturer, pharmaceutical form, route of administration); an identifiable source (province, institution where detected, services involved, reporter or contact details); and an event or outcome identifiable as serious and unexpected with a reasonable suspicion of causal relationship (date and time of occurrence relative to immunisation, description of the event).
f.applicability: Vaccines (events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation, ESAVI)

rows.actor: Anyone notifying an ESAVI to CECMED (including holders and manufacturers)
rows.quote: Información mínima para la comunicación de un ESAVI: Información mínima requerida para la notificación al CECMED de un ESAVI
rows.review_note: Review: definition that fixes the minimum data set for notification; element list (a-d) summarised from the same section. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: definition with list outside the short quote, 85.
rows.quote_en: Minimum information for communicating an ESAVI: Minimum information required for notifying an ESAVI to CECMED

f.applicability: Vaccines (events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation, ESAVI)
